crossRefs.note: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart…

people.name: Caesarea
people.line: Coastal city, center of Roman rule in Judea

people.name: Festus
people.line: Roman governor of Judea; heard Paul's case; sent him to Rome.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart shortly.
translations.bsb: But Festus replied, “Paul is being held in Caesarea, and I myself am going there soon.
translations.kjv: But Festus answered, that Paul should be kept at Caesarea, and that he himself would depart shortly
translations.asv: Howbeit Festus answered, that Paul was kept in charge at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart thither shortly.
